title: More leather and meat
description: Makes animals drop more leather, meat and feathers. Also adds meat drops to goats and horses
body:
Makes animals drop more stuff

currently includes:
- All animals drop leather(except chickens)
- All animals drop more meat(except chickens)
- All animals drop bones
- chickens drop more feathers (8-16)
- horses, donkeys and mules now drop beef
- goats now drop mutton
- pigs drop more meat but less leather than cows

Now you don't need to get a million cows just for a bit of leather

Feel free to use this datapack wherever I don't care.

maybe will get updated in the future.
